# Filter rows where Height column contains a value greater than 1.8 meters
# The Height column is a string with format like "1.83 m (6 ft 0 in)"
# Extract the numeric part before " m" and convert to float
df['height_m'] = df['Height'].str.extract(r'(\d+\.\d+)').astype(float)
# Count rows where height_m > 1.8
count_over_1_8 = (df['height_m'] > 1.8).sum()
answer = int(count_over_1_8)
